<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/credential-rotations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces the credential's password.

Send an empty body and we generate one that satisfies your organization's password policy. Send
a `Password` and it is used instead, provided it meets that policy.

The change is immediate: the old password stops working at once, and anything still using it
will fail to connect. Open sessions are not interrupted.

**The new password is not in the response** — this endpoint returns only a confirmation. Read it
back with the get endpoint, which returns the current password along with the rest of the
credential.
